surfaceVerifierScript:
import json, subprocess, hashlib, sys
S=sys.argv[1]; REPO=sys.argv[2]
d=json.load(open(S+'/contract-proposal-and-source-surface.json',encoding='utf-8'))
def blob(rev,p):
    r=subprocess.run(['git','-C',REPO,'show',f'{rev}:{p}'],capture_output=True)
    return r.returncode, r.stdout
def bsha(rev,p):
    r=subprocess.run(['git','-C',REPO,'rev-parse',f'{rev}:{p}'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    return r.stdout.strip()
tot=0;bad=[];anc=0;ancexact=0;ancstrip=0
for s in d['sourceSurface']:
    p=s['path']
    rc,b=blob('4f97ba71b1482ae70d72dda1833a28fddcd05994',p)
    rc2,b2=blob('100f6f132132199d1204a76190f04712dd82de00',p)
    rc3,b3=blob('60bfc722ff46171af326e2a26cf8764a6dd108ef',p)
    sh=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
    ok = rc==0 and sh==s['sha256'] and bsha('4f97ba71',p)==s['gitBlobSHA1'] and b==b2
    same60 = (b==b3)
    if not ok: bad.append((p,rc,sh==s['sha256'],b==b2))
    lines=b.decode('utf-8').split('\n')
    for a in s['anchors']:
        anc+=1
        L=lines[a['line']-1] if a['line']<=len(lines) else None
        if L==a['text']: ancexact+=1
        elif L is not None and L.strip()==a['text']: ancstrip+=1
        else: bad.append((p,a['line'],a['text'],L))
    tot+=1
    print(f"{p} 4f={'OK' if ok else 'BAD'} same60bf={same60} anchors={len(s['anchors'])}")
print('surfaces',tot,'anchors',anc,'exact',ancexact,'stripMatch',ancstrip,'bad',len(bad))
for x in bad: print('BAD',x)
